title: Imperial Clipper (Elite Dangerous)
intro: The Imperial Clipper by Gutamaya is a large, fast multi-role ship of the Empire. Its cockpit has the pilot seat and one multicrew seat. It needs a large landing pad and uses the shared HOTAS layout.

panels.name: Imperial Clipper: seats and hardpoints
panels.text: Facts about the Imperial Clipper that set it apart from the other ships: its seats, its weapon mounts and the landing pad size it needs.
panels.context: Everything else in the Imperial Clipper's cockpit works like in every other Elite Dangerous ship.

controls.name: Pilot seat (helm)
controls.text: The pilot's seat of the Imperial Clipper, the helm. Whoever sits here flies the ship and has the whole HOTAS layout of this guide.
controls.context: The Imperial Clipper takes up to two people in all; the other seats are for crew who join in multicrew.

controls.name: Multicrew seats
controls.text: The extra seats of the Imperial Clipper, for up to two crew in all. A friend who joins can sit here as gunner, or as fighter controller when the ship carries a fighter.
controls.context: A gunner works the turreted weapons while the pilot flies; the roles are chosen on the role panel.

controls.name: Hardpoints (weapon mounts)
controls.text: The weapon mounts of the Imperial Clipper: two large and two medium hardpoints. Bigger mounts take bigger, stronger weapons.
controls.context: The pilot puts the Imperial Clipper's weapons into fire groups on the right panel and fires them with the trigger and the weapon release button.

controls.name: Landing pad size
controls.text: The Imperial Clipper needs a large landing pad or a bigger one. Stations have small, medium and large pads, and small outposts may not have the bigger ones.
controls.context: When the pilot asks a station for docking, the station gives a pad that fits the ship's size.
